title: MeterReading
description: One multimeter reading typed or spoken by the user in response to a NextAction. The only kind of evidence that counts as proof (I1, I2). Sent to Grain /electrical/check as {net, volts} | {net, pins, continuity} | {net, pins, ohms} (GrainElectricalCheckRequest) and into fusion. `kind` fixes the shape of `value`: voltage_dc -> {volts}; continuity -> {continuity} and pins required; resistance -> {ohms} and pins required. RepairOS's own verdict (`verdict`, judged against [min, max]) is kept apart from Grain's (`grain_verdict`, plus the raw row).

reading_id.description: Sent to Grain as the reading's id once T2 lands.

net.description: Grain net name (GET /electrical nets[].name). Not a harness wire name.

pins.description: REF.PIN ids probed, in Grain's net naming (e.g. J1.1), not harness end names. Required for continuity and resistance; optional for voltage_dc ([probe +, probe -]).

value.description: Exactly the field that matches kind (see allOf).

condition.description: Operating condition when read. RepairOS-side only: Grain's electrical check has no condition input today; we use it to pick which part of the SPICE [min, max] applies.

expected.description: What RepairOS judged against. volts_min/volts_max come from Grain's expected{min, max} (never from expected.volts alone; G2).

verdict.description: RepairOS's verdict, computed in code against expected (inside [min - tol, max + tol], tol = 0.25 V or 5 %; under 5 ohm conducts). Ours wins over Grain's for a rail while G2 is open.

grain_verdict.description: Grain's row verdict (GrainElectricalCheckResponse readings[].verdict). Grain sends only ok|off today; the other values are T2 and, until then, derived by RepairOS (grain_verdict_derived true): continuity false + wire = open, known false = unknown_net, expected null = no_expected, a 'not on net' finding = pin_not_on_net. null when Grain has not been asked or gave nothing to derive from.

grain_verdict_derived.description: True when grain_verdict was derived by RepairOS (G22 fallback), not sent by Grain.

grain_row.description: The raw Grain row for this reading, as returned.

grain_findings.description: Grain findings about this reading (matched by text until T2 adds finding.reading).

grain_remake_wire.description: grain_row.wire.name for an open on a harness wire, if any.

raw_text.description: What the user said or typed, before parsing.

continuity.description: True when the meter beeps / reads under 5 ohm.
